Petitioner-Shri Sushant Sharma, stated to a Swiss National has filed the instant petition through his attorney Sunil Kumar, seeking release Punjab and Haryana High Court, CRWP-9042-2024 (O&M) -2- of his son Madhav Sharma aged 18 years who is stated to be illegally confined by respondent No.3-Ms. Kalindi Harnal in his own house. 
2. It is averred in the petition that petitioner is a Swiss national and a business professional with having educational background from University of St. Gallen, Harvard and Oxford. He had solemnized marriage with Dr. Malavika Goswamy who had been residing in Switzerland, in the year 1997 and son Madhav Sharma was born out of the wedlock who is also a Swiss citizen. 3. Petitioner asserts that he has however, been visiting his son in Chandigarh every year except during Covid period and had lastly visited in April, 2024. It is averred that Madhav Sharma had been residing in House No.171, Punjab and Haryana High Court,
CRWP-9042-2024 (O&M) -3- Sector 19-A, Chandigarh with petitioner's ex wife Dr. Malavika Goswamy. The said house was in the name of Dr. Malavika Goswam. 
4. It is averred that petitioner's former wife Dr. Malavika Goswamy had inherited estate of her brother Dr. Apurva Goswamy by way of registered WILL dated 21.3.2023. Said Dr. Apurva Goswamy had separately created a trust for welfare of his daughter Damini and had also given her a flat in Chandigarh and had also ensured arrangement of sufficient funds for his daughter though,
she had otherwise been excluded from inheriting remaining of his assets. 
5. Petitioner's wife Dr. Malavika Goswamy however, expired on 20.3.2024 and the entire property devolved on Madhav Sharma. 
6. The petitioner asserts that after death of Dr. Malavika Goswamy i.e. petitioner's ex-wife, Ms.
Damini daughter of Dr. Apurva Goswamy had been trying to take control of the estate of late Dr.
Apurva Goswamy which had been inherited by Dr. Malavika Goswamy and had now devolved upon Madhav Sharma. When the petitioner came to India after death of his ex-wife on 23.3.2024 so as to take custody of his son, then respondent No.3-Kalindi Harnal who is aunt (Masi) of petitioner's ex-wife refused to hand over custody of Madhav's Passport and OCI Card and was seen in complete control of the house and the business. Although the petitioner thought that said Ms. Kalindi Harnal was doing everything with genuine intention but later on realized that she had dubious motives to mis-approprirate finances Punjab and Haryana High Court, CRWP-9042-2024 (O&M) -4- and estate of petitioner's ex-wife, now inherited by Madhav Sharma. It is further averred that Ms.

8. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that neither the petitioner nor any of his authorized person is permitted to meet or speak to the detenue and that the petitioner is concerned about the well being of his son and also about his property which is being usurped and squandered away by respondents No.3 and 4. It has thus been submitted that the petitioner's son be got released from illegal custody of respondents No.3 and 4 and that interim custody be handed over to some guardian as may be appointed by this Court to ensure the welfare and well being of the detenue.
